title: kissed, shaggy canadian penne rigate bake
description: a hearty, comforting penne rigate bake with a peppery kick, perfect for a lazy Sunday evening in Canada.
instructions: cook the penne rigate according to the package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
in a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
add the black pepper and salt to the skillet and stir to combine.
in a large bowl, combine the cooked penne rigate, beef mixture, and half of the grana padano cheese.
transfer the mixture to a 20x20cm baking dish and top with the remaining cheese.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the top is golden brown.
remove from the oven and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
